type: AUX physical mechanism only; not an independently paired operational-life import
codec: The exact public raw bit is injected as payload0/1 through the same mobile material channel. No action label, recommended bank, private operand or future condition is injected.
reader: Exactly the existing R04 three physical gates/direction classes; no absence-to-QUERY mapping or result-dependent new gate
calendar: Existing R04 q/boundary and all generic resources; sensor is scheduled at q+3; no environmental quality feedback in the first link screen
advance_to_next_family_if: Nonzero initial sensor RAW, a rejected sensor input, invalid fixed reader after an applied bit, nonempty source before a repeated input, no bit-dependent first response or no repeatable bit-dependent responses
first_link_success_requires: All six inputs applied; all six fixed outputs valid; equal raw bits give the same output in both orders; opposite bits differ; input source is RAW0 before every repeated input. This establishes a reusable prepared perceptual link only, not learning.
early_stop: Before starting an opportunity, reject if it cannot finish within the remaining per-process guard; save actual future if a query has started. No deadline is extended automatically.
after_link_success_proposed_not_yet_auth: Use same sensor and fixed action codec in at most two contrasted consequence histories, then one common opportunity with no feedback, keeping the sensor/reader/anatomy unchanged. Only then choose a MAIN candidate prospectively.
preservation: Each arm loads the complete original native snapshot without cleaning RAW/clocks or importing favorable AUX state. Full checkpoints and exact inputs/receipts remain local. No source S, MAIN or protected life is modified.
